gates.note: PyInstaller 6.22.3 onedir sidecar; shell resolves resources/sidecar; no repo .venv or BORS_PYTHON in installed runs.
Real cached market board, chart switch W/raw/آباد, FTS/fundamental card, market status, company name. Cold 2/3 and warm 3/3 reached all stages; one cold run failed a lazy chunk import.
13 live executions x 5 cases = 65/65 pass; Origin: null always 403; no guard change.

Root killed after full load: exit 1, no survivors, port closed; restart on the same work dir passed all stages.
Sidecar killed while live: visible startup-failed window captured; shell exit 0, port closed; two WebView2 processes exited naturally in 1.1s.
No makensis/ISCC/candle/light; only iexpress and makecab. NSIS/WiX/system-wide install was not authorized; no installer was built or run.
No real installer, so install/uninstall/reinstall gates are blocked. Portable relocation and clean removal of the folder are the only tested deployment.
Get-AuthenticodeSignature: NotSigned for shell, launcher and sidecar. No signtool/osslsigncode; no certificate or private key was read.
No WebView2 bootstrapper is shipped; host runtime 155.0.4283.62 is required.
Removing the system WebView2 runtime is a destructive system-wide change and was not authorized; behavior on a runtime-less machine is unmeasured.
